capital.evidence_quote: Nicosia is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Cyprus

currency.evidence_quote: The Euro is the official legal tender in the Republic of Cyprus

timezone.evidence_quote: Cyprus observes Eastern European Time UTC+2 and Eastern European Summer Time UTC+3

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential electricity in Cyprus is delivered at 230V single phase

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The alternating current frequency across Cyprus is standardized at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Cyprus strictly utilizes British standard Type G three rectangular pin sockets

police.evidence_quote: Emergency police assistance is available via 112 and traditional hotline 199

sources.title: State Health Services Organisation Cyprus Ambulance Service

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency ambulance dispatch operates under unified 112 and 199

fire.evidence_quote: Cyprus Fire Service emergencies are dispatched through 112 and 199

general.evidence_quote: 112 is the primary European emergency number operational 24/7 across Cyprus

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist assistance and emergency translation connect through Cyprus Police via 112

religion.evidence_quote: Greek Orthodoxy represents the primary religious tradition in the Republic of Cyprus

festivals.value: Kıbrıs Bağımsızlık Günü (1 Ekim), Kataklysmos (Tufan Festivali / Pentekost), Limasol Karnavalı (Şubat), Limasol Şarap Festivali
festivals.evidence_quote: Independence Day on October 1 and Kataklysmos festival along coastal towns are major holidays

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Trafik İNGİLTERE GİBİ SOLDAN AKAR; kiralık araç kullanırken sol şerit kuralına dikkat edilmelidir. Prizler İngiliz Tipi G'dir (3 dikdörtgen bacaklı). Yeşil Hat (BM Tampon Bölgesi) geçişlerinde geçerli kimlik veya pasaport taşınmalıdır.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Driving is on the left-hand side of the road; electrical sockets require British Type G plugs

tipping.value: Restoranlarda %10 bahşiş olağandır. Servis ücreti faturaya eklenmemişse nakit veya kartla bırakılması teamüldür.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping roughly 10 percent in restaurants and tavernas is polite and appreciated
